player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Gilliatt''') posted a [[Light]] list on DeckTech in October 2001.
description: This is a winning LS podrace/senator deck.
cards: We Wish To Board At Once
posted: We Wish to Board At Once
posted: Ive Decided to Go Back
notes: Starting cards as posted under 'Starting(5)': Coruscant: Jedi Council Chamber, Boonta Eve Podrace, Anakin's Podracer, Tatooine: Podrace Arena and Security Control; Podrace Prep (the starting interrupt that deploys the arena, podrace, podracer and Security Control) is listed under Interrupts. All count toward the 60. No objective.

The strategy says this is for an Episode 1-only event ('if day one was an Episode 1 event', 'Episode 1 environment'); format left as set — Bill to decide. The Coruscant-set printings are used for Coruscant: Docking Bay, Alter and Sense.
The listed cards total 59, not 60: the post's 'Vehicles(2)' section lists only one Eopie (the strategy speaks of 'Eopies'). Kept as published.

Posted 'Queen Amidala' dested Queen Amidala, Ruler Of Naboo (Coruscant): the Theed Palace Queen Amidala came out after this post, and the strategy's Senate retrieval for Naboo sites is Ruler Of Naboo's game text.
Posted 'Yoda' dested Yoda, Senior Council Member (Coruscant; deploys to the Jedi Council Chamber, destiny 1 as the strategy says) — the Dagobah Yoda is outside the Episode 1 environment.

Posted 'Coruscant Docking Bay' dested the Light Coruscant-set Coruscant: Docking Bay (Coruscant); 'Chancellor Valorum' dested Supreme Chancellor Valorum; 'Obi-Wan Padawan Learner' dested Obi-Wan Kenobi, Padawan Learner; 'Liana Meria' dested Liana Merian; 'A Step Backwards' dested A Step Backward.
The Dark Side counterpart is DeckTech 19237, posted under the same title.
